context:
Work by failure cluster and add regression tests before broad sweeps. Prefer
the existing SQL compatibility registry and Spark helper paths over adding
LakeSail-only special cases. Treat load failures as hard correctness issues
once their root cause is known, because later validation errors often hide the
original load defect.
description:
The 2026-05-12 enabled-platform UAT run proved the LakeSail adapter can
complete several benchmarks: `validator_rollup.tsv` is clean for TPC-H, SSB,
H2O DB, AMPLab, and JoinOrder. The same run failed 17 LakeSail cells across
benchmark-specific SQL, DDL, data loading, and capability gaps.

Representative artifact evidence from
`/Users/joe/Developer/benchmark_runs/logs/uat_enabled_today_platforms_20260512/cells.jsonl`:
TPC-DS hit Spark/LakeSail division-by-zero; TPC-DS OBT rejected quoted alias or
interval syntax around `order count`; metadata primitives rejected `KEY` in
DDL; vector search rejected `FLOAT[128]`; read primitives rejected
`APPROX_TOP_K`; TPC-DI and write/transaction primitives missed expected
staging or mixed-case tables; ClickBench hit non-nullable column load issues;
CoffeeShop rejected colon-prefixed SQL/data syntax; TPCHavoc and TPCH skew
tried to read generated CSV compatibility paths as directories.

Fix all benchmark combinations that can run on current LakeSail. Only add a
compatibility exclusion after a targeted repro proves the current platform
lacks the required feature and the rule includes explicit source evidence.

anti_patterns.dont: add broad string replacements that only match the captured failing query text
modify generated raw UAT artifacts under `benchmark_runs/` or commit result bundles
skip the 17 failing LakeSail benchmarks just because the 2026-05-12 run failed them
weaken validators to make LakeSail appear clean

currently fails at `FLOAT[128]` DDL. Implement SQL-compatible execution if
current LakeSail supports the required semantics; otherwise add explicit,
documented compatibility exclusions.

workload without a SQL schema contract. `vector_search` schema/load now
works; its six vector-distance queries are explicitly skipped for

lambda fallback expressions.
